title: under behind opposite etc. (prepositions)
summary: Предлоги места: **in front of, behind, next to, between, opposite, under, above, on the left / right** — где что находится.
ru:
## Предлоги места
Они отвечают на вопрос «где?» и показывают положение одного предмета относительно другого.
> The cat is **under** the table. — Кошка под столом.
> The bank is **opposite** the school. — Банк напротив школы.

## Основные предлоги
- **in front of** — перед, впереди: *There's a car **in front of** the house.*
- **behind** — позади, за: *The garden is **behind** the house.*
- **next to / beside** — рядом с: *I sit **next to** Anna.*
- **between** — между (двумя): *The café is **between** a bank and a shop.*
- **opposite** — напротив: *The hotel is **opposite** the station.*
- **under** — под: *The shoes are **under** the bed.*
- **above** — над (выше, не касаясь): *There's a lamp **above** the table.*
- **near** — около, недалеко от: *We live **near** the park.*

## on the left / on the right
Слева и справа говорим **on the left / on the right**.
> The post office is **on the left**. — Почта слева.
> Our school is **on the right**, **next to** the bank.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The cat is in the table.~~ → The cat is **under** the table.
- ~~The bank is in front the school.~~ → **in front of** the school (нужно **of**).
- ~~The park is between the school.~~ → **between** needs two things: *between the school and the bank.*
- ~~My house is in the left.~~ → **on the left**.

## Сравните
- **opposite** — через дорогу или комнату, лицом к лицу.
- **next to** — рядом, на одной линии.
- **in front of** — спереди, перед (в одном ряду или у входа).
en:
## Prepositions of place
They tell us where something is in relation to something else.
> The cat is **under** the table.
> The bank is **opposite** the school.

## Main prepositions
- **in front of**: *There's a car **in front of** the house.*
- **behind**: *The garden is **behind** the house.*
- **next to / beside**: *I sit **next to** Anna.*
- **between**: *The café is **between** a bank and a shop.*
- **opposite**: *The hotel is **opposite** the station.*
- **under**: *The shoes are **under** the bed.*
- **above**: *There's a lamp **above** the table.*
- **near**: *We live **near** the park.*

## on the left / on the right
> The post office is **on the left**.
> Our school is **on the right**, **next to** the bank.

## Common mistakes
- ~~The cat is in the table.~~ → The cat is **under** the table.
- ~~in front the school~~ → **in front of** the school.
- ~~in the left~~ → **on the left**.
structure:
## Схема положения
| Предлог | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| in front of | спереди | The bus is in front of the shop. |
| behind | сзади | The ball is behind the sofa. |
| next to / beside | рядом | The bank is next to the café. |
| between A and B | между | The park is between the school and the shop. |
| opposite | напротив | The hotel is opposite the station. |
| under | под | The bag is under the chair. |
| above | над | The clock is above the door. |
| on the left / right | слева / справа | The shop is on the left. |

## Формула
> Предмет + be + **предлог** + другой предмет
> The cinema **is opposite** the bank.

## Запомните
- **in front of**, **next to** — всегда **of / to** на конце.
- **between** + A **and** B.

exercises.title: Где предмет?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте предлог: **under, behind, opposite, between, next to, in front of**.

items.text: The dog is sleeping {{under}} the table.
The school is {{opposite}} the park, across the road.
Our house is {{between}} a bank and a shop.
A tall man was standing {{in front of}} me, so I couldn't see the stage.
I sit {{next to|beside|by}} Tom in class.
The coin rolled {{under}} the chair, and I can't see it.

exercises.title: Описание улицы
exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово: **on the left, on the right, near, opposite, between**.

items.text: The cinema is {{on the left}} when you go down the street, and the bank is {{on the right}}.
The supermarket is {{opposite}} the bank, on the other side of the road.
The post office is {{between}} the bank and a shoe shop.
I live {{near|close to}} the station, only five minutes on foot.
The café is {{opposite}} the cinema (на другой стороне улицы).

items.q: The lamp is ___ the table. (висит выше)
The ball is ___ the sofa. (скрыт за диваном)
Our flat is ___ a bakery and a pharmacy.
The hotel is ___ the station, on the other side of the road.
The bus stop is ___ the left.
There's a car ___ our house. (прямо у входа)

items.q: Как сказать «Слева от меня сидит Анна»?
options: Anna is sitting in my left.
Anna is sitting at left me.
Anna is sitting on my left.

items.q: Как сказать «Магазин между банком и кафе»?
options: The shop is between the bank and the café.
The shop is between the bank.
The shop is between of the bank and the café.
He's in front of the house.
He's in the front the house.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов в скобках.

answers: The bank is opposite the station.
The bank's opposite the station.
My keys are under the newspaper.
The cat is behind the door.
The cat's behind the door.

items.prompt: (the café / between / the bank / and the cinema)
answers: The café is between the bank and the cinema.
The café's between the bank and the cinema.

The car's in front of our house.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: There's a small park near my home.

items.prompt: What is opposite your house or building?
items.sample: There's a supermarket opposite my building.

items.prompt: Where do you sit in class or at work? Who sits next to you?
items.sample: I sit next to the window. My friend Aida sits next to me.

items.prompt: Describe one thing in your room with a place word (under / on / behind ...)
items.sample: My bag is under the desk, and my books are on the shelf above it.
